Callout.Name: Warrant for Arrest
Callout.Message: Wanted person believed at an address.
Callout.Advisory: Name and description confirmed, occupant uncooperative.

Script.Line: He is in there. I saw him at the window half an hour ago.
He does not come out in the day. Only at night.
There is a dog. I am telling you now, there is a dog.

Lines.Approach: Address confirmed and the warrant is live. Nobody has answered the door but somebody is in.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
